description: Connect your Derive notebook to ChatGPT to search and ask about your handwritten STEM notes. Find relevant excerpts, list recent pages, read recognized page text, and inspect available page previews. Text results respect your access to pages, including shared pages. Page previews require an accessible saved thumbnail. The tools do not edit or delete notebook content. Recognized text can contain errors, and long page results can be truncated.

defaultPrompt: What have I worked on recently in my notes?
Search my notes for the chain rule and summarize the relevant pages.
Show me a preview of my most recently edited page and explain its diagrams.
